title: Context of the organization
summary: Understand internal and external issues, interested parties; define the AI management system scope and your AI roles.
evidence: Context and interested-party register; scope statement; AI role statement.

title: Leadership
summary: Top management commitment, an AI policy, and assigned roles and responsibilities.
evidence: Approved AI policy; RACI; management communications.

title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
summary: Plan AI risk assessment, AI risk treatment (with a Statement of Applicability against Annex A) and AI system impact assessment.
evidence: Risk criteria; risk assessment; Statement of Applicability; impact assessments.

title: AI objectives
summary: Set measurable AI objectives and plans to achieve them.

title: Planning of changes
summary: Plan changes to the management system in a controlled way.

title: Support
summary: Resources, competence, awareness, communication and documented information.
evidence: Competence records; awareness training; document control.

title: Operation
summary: Operate planned processes; perform AI risk assessments, risk treatment and impact assessments at planned intervals and on change.
evidence: Operational records; updated assessments; treatment status.

title: Performance evaluation
summary: Monitoring and measurement, internal audit and management review.
evidence: Metrics; audit program and reports; review minutes.

title: Improvement
summary: Continual improvement, nonconformity and corrective action.

title: Policies related to AI (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on documenting and reviewing AI policy and its alignment with other policies.

title: Internal organization (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on roles, responsibilities and reporting of concerns.

title: Resources for AI systems (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on documenting data, tooling, system, computing and human resources.

title: Assessing impacts of AI systems (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on impact assessment process and documentation for individuals, groups and society.

title: AI system life cycle (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on objectives for responsible development, design, verification, deployment, operation, monitoring and technical documentation.
evidence: Life cycle procedures; verification and validation records; technical documentation.

title: Data for AI systems (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on data acquisition, quality, provenance and preparation.
evidence: Data sheets; data quality and provenance records.

title: Information for interested parties (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on system documentation for users, external reporting and incident communication.

title: Use of AI systems (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on processes and objectives for responsible use and intended use.

title: Third-party and customer relationships (Annex A area)
summary: Controls on allocating responsibilities and managing suppliers and customers.
